help.intro:
**Misaka**

Use /commands to browse registered commands, filtered by access. Native modules remain independent of AI: aliases, RSS, currency conversion, weather, stickers, subscription URL generation and relay. Relay is disabled until its owner explicitly enables it; use /contact in private chat to request contact, then chat through the bot after acceptance. AI is demand-loaded only when its provider, fixed preset, credentials and scope are configured and authorized. /ai starts an admitted request; /chats, /memory and /tasks manage your own data and automations. /sticker and /subconv remain private-chat only without an administrator role. Heavy processing is subject to separate resource qualification; subscription conversion runs on your chosen backend. Shuo remains unmigrated; the standalone reminder module is deferred until grammY supports Bot API 10.4 Widgets.
help.table:
**Getting started**

| Task | Entry point |
| --- | --- |
| Browse registered commands, filtered by access | /commands |
| Choose your language | /settings in private chat |
| Check native modules | /modules |
| Request configured, authorized AI capabilities | /ai |
| Manage personal conversations and explicit memory | /chats and /memory in private chat |
| Manage scoped automations | /tasks |
| Convert stickers or download originals (resource limits apply) | /sticker in private chat |
| Generate a subscription conversion URL | /subconv in private chat |
| Request contact with the owner (no administrator role needed) | /contact in private chat |
| Manage aliases or AI availability (superadministrators) | /alias or /aiconfig in private chat |
help.adminPrivate:
**Administration**

Use /stats for runtime status, /addgroup with a group ID to authorize it, /listgroups for paginated authorization management, and /alias to manage command aliases. Use /relay in private chat to explicitly enable and bind this inbox and its actual topic, then accept, decline or block contact requests. Relay requires a configured superadministrator; owner replies must target the exact copied visitor message or request notice, never a presumed last contact.
help.adminGroup:
**Group authorization**

As a configured superadministrator, you can authorize the current group with /addgroup. Open a private chat for other administration.

start: Misaka's native modules are aliases, RSS, currency conversion, weather, stickers, subscription URL generation and relay, independent of AI. Relay requires explicit owner setup; /contact requests contact in private chat. AI capabilities load on demand only after a superadministrator configures providers, fixed presets, credentials and scope grants. Use /ai, /chats, /memory or /tasks; availability depends on permissions and resource qualification. /help explains access and usage; private-chat /settings selects your language. Shuo remains unmigrated; the standalone reminder module awaits grammY Bot API 10.4 Widgets support.

ai.pendingOutcome: Controls closed while the operation was running. Wait for its receipt and read current state before retrying.
ai.busy: Processing. Please wait before using another control.
ai.cancelled: Controls closed. An operation already started may still finish; check its receipt before retrying.
ai.pending: Review the separate proposal and confirm it once.
ai.approvalAccepted: Approval accepted. The run will continue; this is not yet a completion receipt.
ai.unknown: The operation's outcome is unknown. Read current state before retrying; it will not run again automatically.
ai.largeProposal: Read the complete proposed-action.json document above before confirming. No parameters have been omitted.
ai.title: Misaka
ai.unavailable: AI is unavailable in this scope. Existing data and stop controls remain accessible.
ai.usage: Use /ai <message>, /ai stop [run ID], or /ai status <run ID>. Photos (up to 5 per album), audio, PDF and text files require configured input capabilities and byte limits. Video is not supported.
ai.blockedReply: This reply belongs to an expired, foreign, or non-AI prompt. Use its native command again; it was not sent to AI.
ai.unsupported: This attachment is unsupported or exceeds the local safety limit. Video understanding is unavailable.
ai.stopped: Stopped. Already delivered messages are not removed.
ai.expired: This control expired. Reopen its command to read current state.
ai.chatsUsage: Use /chats, /chats new [title], /chats topic <title>, /chats select <ID>, /chats rename <ID> <revision> <title>, /chats history <ID> [cursor], /chats export <ID>, /chats clear <ID> <revision>, or /chats delete <ID> <revision>. Clearing context does not remove Telegram messages or topics.
ai.taskCost: Cost limit per occurrence: {{maxCostMicros}} CNY microunits
ai.memoryUsage: Use /memory, /memory remember <text>, /memory update <ID> <revision> <text>, or /memory delete <ID> <revision>. Misaka does not record profiles automatically. Personal memory is never included in group context.
ai.tasksUsage: Use /tasks, /tasks create <JSON>, /tasks update <JSON>, /tasks pause <ID> <revision>, or /tasks remove <ID> <revision>. Creation and authority changes require human confirmation of the trigger, explicit timezone, target, scope and budget.
ai.adminUsage: Use /aiconfig or /aiconfig disable. Configure providers and write-only credentials in the private admin WebUI, never in Telegram. Changes invalidate affected active runs and standing grants.
ai.topicUnavailable: Private topics are unavailable. Use /chats new to manage a conversation in this chat.
ai.topicCreated: Conversation created in the new private topic.
ai.partial: Incomplete answer: {{reason}} ({{code}}) Completed actions were not rolled back.
ai.outputTooLong: Output exceeds the safe Telegram message limit. Request a shorter answer.

rate.title: Currency conversion
rate.usage:
Provide source and target currencies, with an optional amount at the start or end (default: 1). Currency codes, country names and common names are supported; natural sentences are not parsed.
/rate 100 jp rmb
/rate JPY CNY 100
/rate 100 yen yuan
/rate BTC USD
rate.chooseFrom: Amount {{amount}}: choose the source currency. Ambiguous names and symbols are never guessed.
rate.chooseTo: Amount {{amount}}: choose the target currency. Ambiguous names and symbols are never guessed.
rate.stale: Cached data is shown because refresh failed. Check the update time.
rate.disclaimer: Indicative only, not an executable trading or bank quote. Update frequency is set by the provider. Crypto and fiat use independent sources.
rate.QUERY: Use explicit arguments, for example /rate 100 JPY CNY. Natural sentences are not parsed.
rate.AMOUNT: The amount is invalid or contains extra text. Non-negative decimals and scales such as k or 万 are supported; expressions are not evaluated.
rate.CURRENCY: Specify two recognizable currencies, for example /rate 100 JPY CNY, or open the currency directory.

weather.title: Weather
weather.choose: Several locations matched. Check the country, region, city and district before choosing.
weather.notFound: No precise location matched. Include the city and district; the query will not silently switch to the city centre.
weather.input: Reply to the dedicated ForceReply input prompt, not the navigation panel or a new message, with a city or district such as Beijing Haidian or Tokyo Shinjuku. You may also voluntarily attach a location in that reply. Use /cancel to cancel.
weather.privacy: GPS, IP, phone number and address are not read automatically. Queries do not save a default. Saving requires an explicit private-chat action; coordinates retain two decimal places and can be cleared.
weather.privateDefault: Your personal default is read and changed only in private chat. Specify a location for group queries.
weather.current:

weather.model: Current values are model estimates, not necessarily on-site observations.
weather.fallback: The primary service is unavailable; a fallback provider is shown.
weather.resolution: District matching does not imply separate observations at every point. Weather resolution depends on the provider.
weather.saved: Default location saved for your private-chat queries only.

sticker.title: Sticker conversion
sticker.usage:
In private chat, send a sticker or reply to one with /sticker.
Choose image/animation or file, then a format. Send a pack link for an original-file ZIP. /cancel stops processing.
sticker.animationHint: GIF keeps animation (128 colours, binary transparency). PNG is one frame. Qualified conversion only.
sticker.packLimit: Original-file ZIP: up to 120 items / 20 MiB.
sticker.invalid: This sticker, pack or output is unsupported, invalid or exceeds a safety limit. Send a supported sticker or pack link; arbitrary files are not accepted.
sticker.unavailable: The source or codec is unavailable. Static conversion requires Sharp, TGS requires local WASM, and video requires ffmpeg with VP9 support. Original downloads do not require those codecs.
sticker.uncertain: Telegram's upload result could not be confirmed. The file may already have arrived; check the chat before trying again. It will not be sent again automatically.
sticker.capacity: The source or processing limit has been reached. Wait for a job or panel to finish, or use /cancel to release your panels and stop processing.
sticker.expired: This panel expired. Send the sticker or pack link again.
sticker.cancelled: Cancelled. Files already sent are not recalled.

relay.title: Contact the owner
relay.intro: Request contact with the owner. Your Telegram name, username if present, and user ID are shown to them. After acceptance, supported messages can be copied through the bot. This is not end-to-end encrypted; identifying content is not anonymized.
relay.ownerHint: To reply, reply to the exact copied visitor message or their request notice in this inbox and topic. The contact-name button only opens details; it never selects a recipient. A last contact is never inferred. Visitors receive ordinary bot copies without forwarding attribution, but identifying content you send is not anonymized.
relay.unavailable: Contact through this bot is currently unavailable.
relay.disabled: Relay is disabled. A configured superadministrator must explicitly enable and bind their private inbox and topic; no inbox is chosen automatically.
relay.enableConfirm: Enable relay and bind this private inbox and its actual topic to you? Visitors may request contact, and you decide whether to accept. Messages are copied through Telegram, not end-to-end encrypted. Content that identifies you is not anonymized.
relay.disableConfirm: Disable relay? Delivery will stop, but saved contacts and Telegram messages will not be deleted.
relay.paused: Default forwarding is paused or not yet active. After acceptance, use /contact resume to resume it explicitly. Your contact is not deleted; valid exact relay replies remain separate.
relay.active: Default forwarding is active in this private chat and topic. Supported messages go to the owner. Use /contact pause, /contact resume or /contact end. Other commands and module controls suspend default forwarding; /cancel stops current-scope transient work and pauses it without deleting the contact. Restart or expiry requires explicit resume.
relay.deliveryUnknown: Telegram delivery could not be confirmed. The message may already have arrived; check the conversation before sending it again. It will not be retried automatically.
relay.unsupported: This message cannot be copied by relay. Supported ordinary text, photos, videos, audio, voice, stickers, documents, locations and contacts can be copied; protected or unsupported messages cannot. Album items are copied separately.
relay.expired: This panel expired. Reopen it to read current state; no old operation or forwarding mode will be resumed automatically.

subconv.title: Subscription URL generation
subconv.disclosure: URL generation only: the bot does not fetch or convert subscriptions. Using the URL sends raw subscriptions and parameters to your chosen backend. Keep bearer links private.
subconv.scvWarning: Warning: scv is enabled by default in this fork. It skips TLS certificate verification in generated node configurations, NOT in the bot. Disable it if not needed.
subconv.scvUnknown: The custom scv value is unrecognized. Check your backend's generated-node TLS behavior before use; do not assume verification is enabled or skipped. Bot TLS verification is unchanged.
subconv.copyHint: Copy the complete URL from the code block into your own client. It may remain in Telegram history; do not share it.
subconv.cancelled: Panel cancelled. Temporary inputs were cleared; saved preferences and Telegram history are unchanged.
subconv.expired: Panel expired. Open /subconv again and re-enter temporary inputs; saved preferences remain.
subconv.inputHint: Reply to the matching ForceReply prompt, not as a new message. Back cancels input; Clear removes this field; /cancel closes the panel. Sources: one per line. Custom parameters: name=value per line.
subconv.invalidInput: Check {{field}}: it is missing, invalid or over the limit. No input value is shown.

rss.title: RSS subscriptions ({{count}})
rss.description: Subscriptions belong to this chat and topic. Group administrators or superadministrators manage group subscriptions. Keyword filters are optional and independent per subscription. New subscriptions skip existing items and default to silent notifications. Expand RSS content inside messages or open the original link.
rss.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add an RSS or Atom URL below.
rss.input:
Reply to the dedicated ForceReply input prompt with an RSS or Atom URL, optionally followed by a space and custom title. Do not reply to the navigation panel or send a new message.
Use /cancel to cancel.
rss.filterInput:
Replace {{kind}} for this subscription. Reply to your current dedicated ForceReply prompt in this chat/topic, one keyword per line. Up to {{count}} keywords, each at most {{length}} UTF-16 code units. Blank lines are ignored. The other list is unchanged. Do not reply to the navigation panel or send a new message.
Use /cancel to cancel.
rss.filterHelp: Match literal substrings, not regex, ignoring case after NFKC normalization, in the title or sanitized visible RSS/Atom body/summary (body limited to 8000 UTF-16 code units). Empty include means no include restriction; otherwise any include must match. Any exclude blocks delivery. Both lists empty means no filtering. Each list previews only its first 5 keywords. Relaxing or clearing filters does not backfill skipped items.
rss.usage:
Use /rss to open subscription management. Open a subscription to edit its keyword lists.
/rss add <URL> [title]
/rss remove <ID>
/rss mute <ID> on|off
/rss pause <ID> on|off
/rss filter <ID> opens the keyword summary and edit controls.
/rss filter <ID> clear clears both lists.
rss.added: Subscription saved. Existing items form the baseline; only newly discovered items will be sent.
rss.removed: Unsubscribed. Unsent deliveries have been cancelled.
rss.imagesUnavailable: Images could not be embedded. Open the original images below:
rss.unhealthy: RSS retrieval has failed repeatedly. Automatic retries will back off.

errors.UNSAFE_URL: Only public HTTP/HTTPS feeds are supported. Private networks, custom ports and URLs with credentials are not allowed.
errors.BLOCKED: The site denied access or returned a login/browser verification page instead of RSS. Browser access does not imply bot access; a directly readable feed or site-authorized access method is required.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: The feed returned an HTTP error. Check the URL or try again later.
errors.INVALID_FEED: The response is not valid RSS/Atom or contains unsupported XML structure.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The feed response exceeds the safe size limit.
errors.TIMEOUT: The feed request timed out. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK: Could not connect to the feed site. Try again later.

deliveryErrors.BLOCKED: Telegram denied delivery. Notifications are paused; check that the bot is not blocked or removed before resuming.
deliveryErrors.REJECTED: Telegram rejected a message. It was not automatically resent.
deliveryErrors.UNKNOWN: Some delivery outcomes are unknown. They will not be automatically retried, to avoid duplicate notifications.

alias.title: Command aliases
alias.description: Aliases use the original command's permissions. Entries show the original command -> aliases. Only configured superadministrators can manage aliases, in private chat.
alias.input: Reply to the dedicated ForceReply input prompt with one alias for /{{command}}, without /, spaces, or arguments. Do not reply to the navigation panel or send a new message. /cancel cancels.
alias.invalidName: Use letters, numbers, or underscores, up to 32 characters. Do not include /, spaces, or arguments.
alias.unknownCommand: Choose a registered original command, not another alias.
alias.collision: This name is already a command or an alias for another command. Choose a different name.
alias.changed: Aliases changed elsewhere. Review the latest list before trying again.
alias.usage:
/alias
/alias add help guide
/alias remove help guide

cancelled: Transient work in this user/chat/topic context has been cancelled and drained; forms and non-approval panels are closed, and default relay forwarding is paused. Saved contacts, conversations and delivered messages are not deleted. Independent approvals unrelated to a cancelled AI run remain valid until their own expiry.
privateOnly: Use this command in a private chat with the bot.
unknownCommand: Unknown command. Use /help to see the available commands.
fallback: Use /help for commands. AI requires an enabled provider, fixed preset and permission for this scope; use /ai to check availability.
expired: This button is expired, unavailable, or from an older version. Reopen a fresh panel or run /commands, /settings, /addgroup, /listgroups or /alias again.
outputTooLong: This result is too long to send. Use a smaller page or restart the command.

groups.waiting: This group is not authorized. The bot will try to notify its superadministrators and stay silent until approved; it will not leave on a timer.
groups.adminGuide: This group is not authorized. You are a configured superadministrator: send /addgroup or /addgroup@{{username}} to authorize this group. Existing groups are not automatically authorized when the bot restarts. Use a private chat for settings and other administration.
groups.authorized: This group is authorized. Use /help for available core commands.
groups.revoked: Authorization has been revoked. The bot will no longer process this group's commands and will try to leave.
